bayts.text: I have turned my face to Him Who granted me the folding (of the path), supplicating for my two parents.
I have turned my face to Him with praise, possessed of repentance from error and intent.
Bless the best of creation, Muḥammad, his Family and his Companions, O Eternal Refuge.
Bless him with peace, and forgive my two parents, and expiate the (their) dues.
O You Who favoured me with the wishes, so pardon my father and my mother, through him from whom (comes) pre-eminence.
Save them both from punishment and reckoning, through the Chosen and whoever is related to him.
Write for him the best blessing with peace, with his Family, and hold back blame from them both.
You are the Forgiving: forgive me and them both, and the people of Islām, and have mercy on them both.
To You I have turned, longing from You for their triumph, and I am already pleased with You.
Write for each of them both a lasting happiness, O You to Whom belongs the bringing back.
Save them both, O Accepter of repentance, in the grave and at the resurrection, from reproach.
Keep them both safe together from fears, at the raising and the gathering, and from shame.
Have mercy on them, Lord, as they raised me when small (Qurʾān 17:24), through the Leader of the Prophets.
Your Prophet, the guide of creation, Muḥammad: bless him with peace, O my Eternal Refuge.
By his mighty standing increase for me the folding (of the path), and forgive it for me and my two parents.
Turn toward my two parents the best forgiveness, the best happiness and the best glad tidings.
Have mercy on them in the grave, at the resurrection, the raising and the gathering; and increase my vigil.
Grant me the vigil of every night with the sūras, and save me from heedlessness and weakness.
I have called upon You, O Allah, O Answerer, by the standing of him by whose standing You answer.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Near (Al-Qarīb) and Answerer (Al-Mujīb),
grant my father and grant my mother forever forgiveness and mercy, through Aḥmad.
Remove dues and sins from them, by his mighty standing, and honour them both.
Drive the blessing to the Prophet with peace, in his Family; and for them both be, O Peace (As-Salām).
Purify their two records of all that brings straitness, and efface it, and keep them safe.
Answer, by the standing of the Chosen, and bless him with peace, and reward all of me with thanks.
